method: Contributions made by PAC committees whose FEC-registered name matches a published term list, to the principal and candidate-authorized committees of 2026 Senate candidates. Excludes party committees, joint fundraising committees and leadership PACs — that is somebody else's money, not the candidate's. Excludes individual contributions from company employees, so every total is a floor, not a full industry figure. Rows are deduplicated on the FEC's sub_id.
